name: Sleep-EDF
description: Polysomnographic sleep data from 99 subjects (SCs) across 2 nights each. Contains Fpz-Cz, Pz-Oz EEG channels, EOG, and EMG. Includes expert-scored hypnograms (W, N1, N2, N3, REM) and sleep quality metrics (sleep efficiency, total sleep time, sleep latency).

sleep_stage.description: Expert-scored sleep stage annotation per 30-second epoch

sleep_efficiency.description: Sleep efficiency = total sleep time / time in bed × 100
sleep_efficiency.note: Derived from expert-scored annotations, not from band-power features

preprocessing_requirements.channel_montage: Fpz-Cz, Pz-Oz (requires channel expansion for 19-channel models)

scientific_status: GROUNDED_TRUTH — PSG annotations are expert-scored, independent of model input features
label_derivation: Labels are manually annotated by trained sleep technologists reviewing full PSG recordings. NOT derived from EEG signal analysis.
circularity_risk: NONE — labels assigned by human experts, not computed from features
